column1: # Global shortcuts (ported from the Hyprland setup, SUPER == Meta).
# One source of truth: setup.sh writes these into kglobalshortcutsrc and
# bin/bindings-help renders them as the cheat sheet.
#   component | action | keys | description
#   component  kglobalshortcutsrc group; nested groups use '/'
#              (services/<id>.desktop -> [services][<id>.desktop]);
#              "help" rows are only shown in the cheat sheet, never applied
#   keys       ';' separates alternatives; 'none' clears a binding
#              (cleared rows are not listed in the help)
## Apps
services/com.mitchellh.ghostty.desktop | _launch | Meta+Q | Open terminal
services/helium.desktop | _launch | Meta+B | Open browser
services/org.kde.dolphin.desktop | _launch | Meta+E | Open file manager
services/org.kde.krunner.desktop | _launch | Meta+Space;Alt+Space;Alt+F2 | Open app launcher (KRunner)
plasmashell | show-on-mouse-pos | Meta+Ctrl+V | Clipboard history
services/bindings-help.desktop | _launch | Meta+K | Show this keybinding help
services/theme-toggle.desktop | _launch | Meta+Shift+T | Toggle dark/light theme
## Session
ksmserver | Lock Session | Screensaver;Meta+L | Lock screen
ksmserver | Log Out | Ctrl+Alt+Del;Meta+M | Power menu: log out / restart / shut down
## Screenshots
services/org.kde.spectacle.desktop | FullScreenScreenShot | Print | Full-screen screenshot (saves + copies)
services/org.kde.spectacle.desktop | RectangularRegionScreenShot | Shift+Print | Region screenshot (saves + copies)
services/org.kde.spectacle.desktop | _launch | Meta+Print | Open Spectacle
## Windows
kwin | Window Close | Alt+F4;Meta+C | Close window
kwin | Window Maximize | Meta+PgUp;Meta+F | Maximize window
kwin | Window Fullscreen | Meta+Shift+F | Real fullscreen
kwin | Window Raise | Meta+Home | Bring window to the front
kwin | Window Lower | Meta+End | Send window to the back
kwin | Walk Through Windows | Alt+Tab;Meta+Tab | Cycle to next window
kwin | Walk Through Windows (Reverse) | Alt+Shift+Tab;Meta+Shift+Tab | Cycle to previous window
kwin | Window Move Center | Meta+Ctrl+5 | Center window
kwin | Window Quick Tile Bottom Left | Meta+Ctrl+1 | Quarter-tile: bottom-left
kwin | Window Quick Tile Bottom Right | Meta+Ctrl+2 | Quarter-tile: bottom-right
kwin | Window Quick Tile Top Left | Meta+Ctrl+3 | Quarter-tile: top-left
kwin | Window Quick Tile Top Right | Meta+Ctrl+4 | Quarter-tile: top-right
## Window management (KDE defaults)
kwin | Edit Tiles | Meta+T | Edit tiles (KDE tile editor)
kwin | Window Quick Tile Left | Meta+Left | Quick-tile window to the left half
kwin | Window Quick Tile Right | Meta+Right | Quick-tile window to the right half
kwin | Window Quick Tile Top | Meta+Up | Quick-tile window to the top half
kwin | Window Quick Tile Bottom | Meta+Down | Quick-tile window to the bottom half
kwin | Switch Window Left | Meta+Alt+Left | Switch to the window on the left
kwin | Switch Window Right | Meta+Alt+Right | Switch to the window on the right
kwin | Switch Window Up | Meta+Alt+Up | Switch to the window above
kwin | Switch Window Down | Meta+Alt+Down | Switch to the window below
kwin | Window to Next Screen | Meta+Shift+Right | Move window to the next screen
kwin | Window to Previous Screen | Meta+Shift+Left | Move window to the previous screen
kwin | Window On All Desktops | none | -
